scope: Desktop direct cursor aiming and stronger protected chromatic optics; touch retains reverse pull.

desktopBrowser.includes: 7px/9px jitter, live retarget, return-to-origin, camera pan, Escape, right cancel, off-canvas release, capture loss, full-power label and preview/release equality

webGL.method: Controlled actual software WebGL: desktop/portrait, motion/reduced, Off/idle/focus/release/native-earned-chain; read-only state and cleanup assertions.

ordinaryStartRun.injections: Only tutorial-completion, motion and PostFX On preferences. No run, HP, actor, charge or renderer-state injection. Debug state and draw trace are read-only.
ordinaryStartRun.limitations: Short scripted ordinary interaction run, not a human usability study. Latest recording has zero kills: launch/cancel success is not proof of hit success. Software GPU, no hardware FPS/latency certification. Video records WebGL canvas, not DOM HUD/pointer label.

git: No commit or push. Prior working-tree changes preserved.
historicalNotice: Superseded by docs/inverted-controls/validation.json. This file records the previous direct-aim experiment, not current acceptance criteria.
